messages:
julia-support: Hey @antonio — customer Akshay (org: lumin) is seeing intermittent 504s and long tail latency on their Dedicated pool. Example request id: req_8a3f2b. Can you help gather repro logs and a debug bundle? They ran a curl repro below.

customer-akshay: Here's the exact curl we used:
```
curl -v 'https://dedicated.us.redwood.ai/v1/completions' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-dedicated-1","input":"short prompt"}'
```

antonio-sre: Thanks. Can you confirm the approximate UTC time and paste the full response headers/body if you have them? Also tenant and any pod/node names seen in your metrics. I can grep proxy and runtime logs for req_8a3f2b.

julia-support: Reported ~2026-11-05T18:22:14Z. Tenant: lumin-prod. We see the request roughly in metrics for pod inference-ssd-5f8c7 on node gpunode-eu-12. I've uploaded the curl stdout to the ticket.

antonio-sre: Copy. I'll collect these artifacts. On support/control-plane run:
```
# pull pod logs and describe
kubectl -n dedicated-lumin logs inference-ssd-5f8c7 --since=30m > pod.log
kubectl -n dedicated-lumin describe pod inference-ssd-5f8c7 > pod.describe
```
On the node gpunode-eu-12 (ssh):
```
# node-level checks
sudo journalctl -u kubelet -o short-iso | grep "req_8a3f2b" > node.journal || true
sudo dmesg | tail -n 200 > dmesg_tail.txt
nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY -i 0 > nvidia_mem.txt
# lightweight GPU util snapshot
sudo nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,utilization.memory --format=csv -i 0 > gpu_util.csv
```
I'll also pull proxy/nginx access logs and the runtime request debug trace.

ops-bot: debug-bundle-create: bundle id dbg-20261105-antonio-9843 created, uploading -> s3://redwood-debug-bundles/lumin/dbg-20261105-antonio-9843.zip

mei-eng: I'll inspect model runtime traces and KV cache stats once the bundle is ready. If possible ask the customer to re-run the curl with an extra header so we can correlate a TCP/TLS trace and a captured X-Request-Id:
```
curl -v 'https://dedicated.us.redwood.ai/v1/completions' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'X-Request-Id: req_8a3f2b' \
  --trace-ascii curl_trace.txt \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-dedicated-1","input":"short prompt"}'
```

customer-akshay: Rerun complete, uploaded curl_trace.txt to the support case: https://support.redwood.ai/cases/5482/attachments/trace. Response still shows occasional 504 and long first-byte times.

antonio-sre: Got the trace and bundle. Bundle dbg-20261105-antonio-9843 now includes: pod.log, pod.describe, node.journal, dmesg_tail.txt, nvidia_mem.txt, gpu_util.csv, nginx_access.log, runtime_trace.json, and the customer's curl_trace.txt. I'm attaching it to the ticket and escalating to eng-runtime for a deeper performance dive. Assigning to @mei-eng. :thumbsup:

julia-support: Thanks — I'll update the customer with the bundle link and keep the case open until eng-runtime confirms a root cause.
